name: Cascade
description: The multiattack cost is inherently reduced by one. Additionally, Once one attack strikes a target, all further strikes against that target also hit.  If at least two strikes hit a target they are slowed until the start of the character’s next turn.  If at least three strikes hit a target all attacks made as a part of this Weapon Attack against that target are considered Critical Hits and do double damage.

name: Overwatch
mp_cost: 4 MP per activation + 1 MP per additional rank
description: The character executes an action; they may select a point within their weapon's range and apply suppressive fire in a 10' radius area until the start of their next turn. Should anyone in the area take a movement or core action - the character is granted the ability to attack the target with 3 MP + 1 MP per additional rank. Those in the area have a displaced roll on any AGI checks / saves and have a displaced roll on attack rolls.

name: Interrupt
description: The next successful strike this turn interrupts an enemy. An interrupt cancels whatever action the target last attempted to execute should they fail a HEA save. Interrupts only function if the character is somehow able to activate the ability on the target's turn, such as through the use of Overwatch.Shred (2 MP per rank): All successful strikes reduce the targets' armor DVs by 1 per rank if they at least hit the target's movement DVs.

name: Shred
description: All successful strikes reduce the targets’ armor DVs by 1 per rank if they at least hit the target’s movement DVs.  This lasts until the start of the character’s next turn.

name: Disarming Attack
description: The next successful strike this turn knocks whatever the target is holding in their hands 10' away in a direction of the target's choice.

name: Concussive
description: The next successful strike this turn befuddles the target until the end of their next turn, WIL save to negate.
